subject: FinSecure sprint kickoff: SOC 2 artifacts & audit-log retention checklist
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finsecure.com>, Maya Patel <maya.p@finsecure.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinSecure sprint kickoff: SOC 2 artifacts & audit-log retention checklist

Hi Alex / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on an evidence sprint for SOC 2 and retention requirements. High-level pain points you flagged:

- Need sample audit log exports (WORM/immutable storage) that show 7 days and 90 days retention views for our reviewers.
- Clarify where PII / request logs are stored and the purge policy tied to your data retention window.
- DPA redlines: a short list of clauses FinSecure wants adjusted (data residency + subprocessor notice cadence).
- Pen-test scheduling and evidence: you need our standard pen-test scope and preferred windows; you also asked about previous findings and remediation notes.

What we committed to on the call:
- Neha: share an evidence matrix mapping SOC 2 sections to artifacts + a sample audit log (CSV stub) you can send to auditors. (attached)
- Logan: provide the DPA redline summary and a first-pass doc for your legal team.
- Irene: join the next technical sync to walk through log retention architecture and where the retention control plane lives.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (by EOD): Evidence matrix + CSV sample + DPA draft (see attachments).
- Mon 10/4: 30-minute technical sync (Irene + Alex) to review audit-log exports and retention controls.
- Wed 10/6: Pen-test scope doc and proposed windows (if that still works for you).

Can you confirm the Monday window works for a 30-minute handoff (we're suggesting Mon 10/4 10:00am PT) and whether the auditors need any extra format for the log extract?

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales (Security Lead)
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample-audit-logs-7days.csv (CSV), DPA-draft-finsecure-redlines.docx (docx)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finsecure.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@finsecure.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure sprint kickoff: SOC 2 artifacts & audit-log retention checklist

Hi Neha —

Appreciate the clear recap. Monday 10/4 10:00am PT works for the technical sync — please send a calendar invite. A few clarifications from our side:

- For audit logs, our auditors prefer JSON-line exports but CSV is fine as a quick sample; ideally include a couple of examples that show both auth events and data-access events.
- Retention: we need to validate the difference between immutable (WORM) storage and soft-delete. If you can show the workflow (where the log sits, who can delete, retention enforcement), that will be helpful.
- DPA: our legal team will focus on subprocessor notice (30 days) and vendor breach SLAs. We'll send a redline to your DPA-draft by Monday EOD.
- Pen test window: target the week of 10/18 — our security ops lead needs to confirm internal maintenance windows but that week is likely.

Also looping in our security alias in case we need to share a SOC 2 auditor contact: security@finsecure.com.

Thanks —
Alex
Head of Security Engineering
FinSecure
alex.johnson@finsecure.com
+1 (212) 555-0901

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finsecure.com>, security@finsecure.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSecure sprint kickoff: SOC 2 artifacts & audit-log retention checklist

Thanks Alex — good notes. Calendar invite for Mon 10/4 10:00am PT sent. Irene, joining you here:

Irene — can you prep a short diagram (15 minutes) showing:
- audit-log flow (app -> ingestion -> cold archive)
- where immutability/WORM is enforced (storage + retention policy enforcement points)
- which roles can request deletions and the approval workflow

If you can upload the diagram to the Drive link below before the sync that would be ideal; I'll share the Drive link with FinSecure attendees so auditors have the folder.

Logan — can you confirm you'll drop the DPA redline summary into the same Drive folder so Alex's legal team can access it?

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bFinSecure-Evidence
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/FS-2027-09-30

Neha

- I'll upload two items to the Drive folder by tonight: 1) "log-retention-architecture-10-04.pdf" (diagram + enforcement points) and 2) "export-schema-examples.jsonl" (3 example JSONL records covering auth, data-access, config-change).
